How many real numbers x satisfy (x − 1) + (x + 2) = 5?
(A) 0 (B) 1 (C) 2 (D) 3 (E) Infinitely many

solution.text:
The left side is |x − 1| + |x + 2|. It equals −2x − 1 for x < −2, 3 for −2 ≤ x ≤ 1, and 2x + 1
for x > 1. Hence the solutions are x = −3 and x = 2.
